requirements.description: Create the standalone Gemini adapter and Selenium control loop. Save per-screen prompt/response/submission/state evidence and screenshots without secrets.
requirements.intent: Finish connecting Gemini to the existing HTML interface through Selenium as required by Gemini-handoff.md.

requirements.intent: Verify the new adapter's correctness without treating a simulated model response as live Gemini execution.
